no_https.reason_en: The link does not use a secure connection (HTTPS)

at_symbol.reason_en: The link uses a trick to hide where it really goes

ip_address.reason_en: The link uses a number address instead of a website name

punycode.reason_en: The link may use lookalike letters to copy a real website name

malformed.reason_en: The link is broken or unusually formatted

suspicious_tld.reason_en: The website ending is often used by scam sites

shortener.reason_en: The link is shortened, which hides where it really goes

brand_impersonation.reason_en: The link uses the name '{brand}' but is not the official {brand} website
